# CastTo Matrix Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement the full supported `CastTo<T>` matrix so every documented source/target pair follows the required success, default-error, and conditional-success rules.

**Architecture:** `src/convert/cast.rs` consumes the `CastTo<T>` trait from `element` and provides the complete conversion matrix for the supported Xenon element set. `element_index` stays unset inside every `CastTo<T>` impl; the tensor-level caller fills it later.

**Tech Stack:** Rust, `CastTo<T>`, `Complex<f32>`, `Complex<f64>`, `XenonError::TypeConversion`

**Design Docs:** `design/21-type.md` §5.3-§5.4 (matrix and closure rules), §6.1 (sample impls), §8.2 and §8.8 (tests), §10 (error model)

**Prerequisites:** W24T1, W5 (`Complex<T>`), and the public `XenonError::TypeConversion` payload must be complete.

---

### Task 2: Implement the documented conversion matrix

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/convert/cast.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Implement the sample canonical impls exactly as shown**

Add these exact `CastTo<T>` implementations from the design:

```rust
impl CastTo<f32> for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn cast_to(self) -> Result<f32, XenonError> {
        Err(XenonError::TypeConversion {
            source_type: TypeId::of::<f64>(),
            target_type: TypeId::of::<f32>(),
            reason: ConversionFailureReason::LossyFloatNarrowing,
            element_index: None,
        })
    }
}

impl CastTo<f64> for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn cast_to(self) -> Result<f64, XenonError> { Ok(self as f64) }
}

impl CastTo<i64> for i32 {
    #[inline]
    fn cast_to(self) -> Result<i64, XenonError> { Ok(self as i64) }
}

impl CastTo<f64> for Complex<f64> {
    #[inline]
    fn cast_to(self) -> Result<f64, XenonError> {
        if self.im == 0.0 {
            Ok(self.re)
        } else {
            Err(XenonError::TypeConversion {
                source_type: TypeId::of::<Complex<f64>>(),
                target_type: TypeId::of::<f64>(),
                reason: ConversionFailureReason::NonZeroImaginaryPart,
                element_index: None,
            })
        }
    }
}

impl CastTo<i32> for i64 {
    #[inline]
    fn cast_to(self) -> Result<i32, XenonError> {
        Err(XenonError::TypeConversion {
            source_type: TypeId::of::<i64>(),
            target_type: TypeId::of::<i32>(),
            reason: ConversionFailureReason::LossyIntegerNarrowing,
            element_index: None,
        })
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Close the full documented matrix**

Finish the implementation so it covers all documented categories:

```text
Success-by-default:
- i32 -> i64
- f32 -> f64
- i32 -> f64
- i32 -> Complex<f64>
- f32 -> Complex<f64>
- f32 -> Complex<f32>
- f64 -> Complex<f64>
- Complex<f32> -> Complex<f64>

Default-error:
- i64 -> i32
- f64 -> f32
- f32 -> i32
- f32 -> i64
- f64 -> i32
- f64 -> i64
- i32 -> f32
- i64 -> f32
- i64 -> f64
- i32 -> Complex<f32>
- i64 -> Complex<f64>
- i64 -> Complex<f32>
- f64 -> Complex<f32>
- Complex<f64> -> Complex<f32>

Conditional-success:
- Complex<f32> -> f64
- Complex<f32> -> f32
- Complex<f32> -> i32
- Complex<f32> -> i64
- Complex<f64> -> f64
- Complex<f64> -> f32
- Complex<f64> -> i32
- Complex<f64> -> i64
```

Encode the exact closure rules from the design:

```text
- real -> complex: convert the real part first, then add zero imaginary part
- complex -> real: require imag == 0, then apply the inner real conversion rule
- complex -> complex: convert real and imaginary parts independently
- any lossy inner step fails the whole conversion
```
